items.prompt: A large forest clearing on a September morning: about forty people sit on rows of mismatched chairs in the open air, and a man stands alone in front of them at an invisible line, speaking; mist lifting off the grass, birches around.

alt.ru: Большая лесная поляна сентябрьским утром: около сорока человек сидят рядами на разномастных стульях под открытым небом, перед ними у невидимой черты стоит и говорит один человек; над травой поднимается туман.
alt.en: A large forest clearing on a September morning: about forty people on rows of mismatched chairs in the open air, one man standing before them at an invisible line, speaking; mist lifting off the grass.
alt.pt: Uma grande clareira numa manhã de setembro: cerca de quarenta pessoas em filas de cadeiras desemparelhadas ao ar livre, um homem de pé diante delas numa linha invisível a falar; névoa a levantar da relva.
alt.es: Un gran claro del bosque una mañana de septiembre: unas cuarenta personas en filas de sillas dispares al aire libre, un hombre de pie ante ellas en una línea invisible hablando; niebla levantándose de la hierba.

items.prompt: A wide forest clearing seen from far behind rows of seated people: at the front, small in the distance, a single figure stands alone facing them, and for a moment the whole clearing is utterly still, the morning light gathered more brightly around that one distant figure, the birches motionless.

alt.ru: Лесная поляна издалека из-за рядов сидящих людей: впереди, маленькая на расстоянии, одна стоит фигура, вся поляна замерла, утренний свет вокруг неё чуть ярче.
alt.en: A forest clearing seen from far behind rows of seated people: at the front, small in the distance, a single figure stands alone, the whole clearing still, the morning light a little brighter around it.
alt.pt: Uma clareira vista de longe por trás de filas de pessoas sentadas: à frente, pequena na distância, uma figura sozinha de pé, toda a clareira imóvel, a luz da manhã mais clara à volta dela.
alt.es: Un claro del bosque visto de lejos tras filas de gente sentada: al frente, pequeña en la distancia, una figura sola de pie, todo el claro inmóvil, la luz de la mañana algo más brillante a su alrededor.
